import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[][] directions = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int source, sink, edge_idx=1, grid_size, max_time, INF, head[], q_buffer[], edges[][], depth_map[][], dist_map[][], point_map[][], supply_map[][];
    static char gridA[][], gridB[][];
    static final int MAX_N = 20;
    static final int MAX_Q = 1000000;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 1000000;
    static final int MAX_POINTS = 1000;
    static int[] flow_array = new int[MAX_POINTS];
    
    static class Edge {
        int v, cap, rev;
        Edge(int v, int cap, int rev) {
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }
    
    static ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
    
    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, cap, adj[v].size()));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, adj[u].size() - 1));
    }
    
    static void run_bfs(int x0, int y0, boolean check) {
        int l=0, r=0, id=point_map[x0][y0];
        q_buffer[r++]=x0*1000 + y0;
        for (int i=0; i<dist_map.length; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_map[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
        INF=dist_map[0][0];
        dist_map[x0][y0]=0;
        while (l<r) {
            int val=q_buffer[l++];
            int x=val/1000, y=val%1000;
            if (check && supply_map[x][y]!=0 && dist_map[x][y]<=max_time && dist_map[x][y]<=depth_map[x][y])
                add_edge(id, supply_map[x][y], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            if (dist_map[x][y]>max_time || dist_map[x][y]>=depth_map[x][y]) continue;
            if (id==3 && supply_map[x][y]==9) System.out.println(dist_map[x][y]);
            for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
                int nx=x+directions[i][0], ny=y+directions[i][1];
                if (nx>0 && nx<=grid_size && ny>0 && ny<=grid_size && Character.isDigit(gridA[nx][ny]) && dist_map[nx][ny]==Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    dist_map[nx][ny]=dist_map[x][y]+1;
                    q_buffer[r++]=nx*1000+ny;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean build_path() {
        Arrays.fill(flow_array, 0);
        int l=0, r=0;
        q_buffer[r++]=source;
        flow_array[source]=1;
        while (l<r) {
            int x=q_buffer[l++];
            for (Edge e : adj[x]) {
                int y=e.v;
                if (flow_array[y]!=0 || e.cap==0) continue;
                flow_array[y]=flow_array[x]+1;
                q_buffer[r++]=y;
                if (y==sink) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int max_flow(int x, int flow) {
        if (x==sink) return flow;
        int remaining=flow;
        for (Edge e : adj[x]) {
            int y=e.v;
            if (flow_array[y]!=flow_array[x]+1 || e.cap==0) continue;
            int pushed=max_flow(y, Math.min(remaining, e.cap));
            e.cap-=pushed;
            adj[y].get(e.rev).cap+=pushed;
            remaining-=pushed;
            if (remaining==0) return flow;
        }
        if (remaining==flow) flow_array[x]=-1;
        return flow - remaining;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st=new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        grid_size=Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        max_time=Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        gridA=new char[grid_size+1][grid_size+1];
        gridB=new char[grid_size+1][grid_size+1];
        depth_map=new int[grid_size+1][grid_size+1];
        dist_map=new int[grid_size+1][grid_size+1];
        point_map=new int[grid_size+1][grid_size+1];
        supply_map=new int[grid_size+1][grid_size+1];
        for (int i=1; i<=grid_size; i++) {
            String line=br.readLine();
            for (int j=1; j<=grid_size; j++) {
                gridA[i][j]=line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=grid_size; i++) {
            String line=br.readLine();
            for (int j=1; j<=grid_size; j++) {
                gridB[i][j]=line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        for (int i=0; i<=grid_size; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(depth_map[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(dist_map[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
        adj=new ArrayList[1000];
        for (int i=0; i<1000; i++) {
            adj[i]=new ArrayList<>();
        }
        int t=1;
        source=0; sink=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=grid_size; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j]>'0' && gridA[i][j]<='9') {
                    point_map[i][j]=++t;
                    add_edge(source, t, gridA[i][j]-'0');
                }
                if (gridB[i][j]>'0' && gridB[i][j]<='9') {
                    supply_map[i][j]=++t;
                    add_edge(t, sink, gridB[i][j]-'0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=grid_size; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=grid_size; j++) {
                if (point_map[i][j]!=0) run_bfs(i,j,true);
            }
        }
        int total=0;
        while (build_path()) total+=max_flow(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
